name: ZCZL Industrial Technology Group Company Limited
summary: ZCZL Industrial Technology Group Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells coal mining and excavating equipment for coal mining industry in the People's Republic of China, Germany, and internationally. It provides coal mining equipment, hydraulic supports, and scraper conveyors. The company also offers power, chassis, sealing, drive, and new energy electric drive systems under the ASIMCO, SEG, and SES brands.
